name: Soulmates Ventures
aliases: Soulmates Ventures, osoba rizikového kapitálu, s.r.o.
decision_note: Prague-based sustainability (SFDR Art. 9) VC (EUR 62m AUM per its site; EUR 50m fund announced in 2025) with Czech portfolio companies (e.g. Flowpay); led rounds in Rightcharge (Oct 2025, follow-on Sep 2026), FluoSphera (Jan 2026) and Antiverse (Mar 2026).

legal_entities.name: Soulmates Ventures, osoba rizikového kapitálu, s.r.o.

funds.name: Soulmates Ventures Fund SICAV (EUR 50m Article 9 fund, announced; no close reported)

evidence.quote: We fund each company with an initial investment of up to €3,000,000 to improve systems and products that positively impact both people’s lives and the planet, focusing on key areas such as air, water, energy, mobility, education, healthcare, food and agriculture, and the circular economy.
expanding from Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) to the entire European market
The fund will provide initial investments of up to €3 million per startup, with follow-on funding of up to €5 million to ensure that startups receive long-term support.
And that’s where the £500K follow-on round we led alongside BlackWood Ventures and Purple Ventures comes in handy.
The round was led by Soulmates Ventures with participation from Innovation Investment Capital, DOMiNO Ventures, and existing investors DBW, Kadmos Capital, and i&i Biotech Fund

We led the round alongside a Swiss business angel, with IndieBio New York participating, toward one goal – to back FluoSphera’s groundbreaking mission to reinvent drug research and testing, one clinical trial at a time.
Soulmates Ventures has led a £1.6 million seed investment in Rightcharge, a London-based company simplifying electric vehicle (EV) charging payments for businesses across Europe.
Better Medicine has just secured €1 million in pre-seed funding, with Soulmates Ventures leading the round alongside Specialist VC, UT Ventures, and several angel investors.
Flowpay, a pioneering fintech company from the Czech Republic, is revolutionizing the financing landscape for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
In 2025, we announced a cohort with a €50M fund and five new companies joined our portfolio

analyst_notes: Capital: EUR 50m fund announced March 2025 (AIN 2025-03-18; recorded as event 'launch' because sources say 'announced/expansion of' the fund, not a final close; the SICAV and sub-fund SVF 01 were registered in ARES on 2025-05-21/22). The investor's homepage (undated) shows 'Assets Under Management €62M', 'Initial Ticket Size up to €3M' and 'Target stage Seed/SA'; the dated fund size is used for capital. Ticket: up to EUR 3m initial (follow-ons up to EUR 5m total); Lupa (2025, author Soulmates) says the historical average ticket was EUR 700k. Stage derived from cited rounds (pre-seed Better Medicine, seed Rightcharge/FluoSphera, Series A Antiverse), consistent with the site's 'Seed/SA'. Publication dates of the investor's own news pages are from their datePublished metadata; the FluoSphera round date is taken as the page date (2026-01-14). The site self-describes as a 'green investing accelerator' with a hands-on acceleration programme, but its main activity is fund investing, so the accelerator flag is not set. Healthcare focus includes biotech deals (Antiverse, FluoSphera). [revision 2026-10-25 re-audit: capital changed from EUR 50m 'latest_fund_size' to EUR 62m AUM (homepage 'Assets Under Management €62M', undated, as_of = retrieval date). The EUR 50m Art. 9 fund is only ever described as announced / 'expansion of' (AIN 2025-03-18) and in Soulmates' own 2025 review (2026-01-30, e11) as 'a cohort with a €50M fund'; no first/final close or committed amount is published, so it stays a fund entry with event launch and is not used as capital. Scope rule: Prague HQ (two Prague offices on the site) plus a Czech portfolio company added - Flowpay, Czech SME-lending fintech, seed round with Techstars and DEPO Ventures, case page 'Invested 01/2024' (month only, so dated 2024-01-01; pre-window, scope evidence only). Activity unchanged (Rightcharge follow-on 2026-09-07, own page). Type vc unchanged (fund investing dominant; acceleration programme is secondary). Ticket 'up to €3M' initial = per-company, stated.]
